address: La Vallee de Rozel, Rozel Bay, Jersey,JE3 6AJ
bio: Originally built in 1843, Chateau La Chaire is a stunning boutique hotel located in the woody valley of Rozel in Jersey.  The hotel is set within 8 1/2 acres of woodland valley that was once landscaped in 1841 by Samuel Curtis, a botanist from Kew Gardens.  This small,  luxury hotel boasts sensational views, offering the perfect setting to enjoy Afternoon Tea.  You can tuck into a selection of finger sandwiches, cakes, and scones with homemade strawberry jam and Jersey black butter.
